gaps: No stimulus images in data/: timelines were rendered at run time from js/gen_viz.js at each participant's window size; re-rendered here at 1440x900, so absolute sizes/label spacing differ from what any given participant saw.
css/style.css (referenced by the experiment HTML) is missing from data/; the spiral's .stroke-text label halo is approximated from the survey screenshots.
